entries.requirement: Sign up and be studying within a minute; the 7-day trial starts at once, with no card up front.
entries.notes: Local auth on the real binary, desktop and mobile. Clerk: the server-rendered sign-up page with stand-in keys only; no real Clerk sign-up.

entries.requirement: A learner on the trial knows the days left, can add a card any time with nothing charged until it ends, and is told calmly where to add one when the trial or its allowance runs out.
entries.notes: Chip 7 and 6 days, last day, ended; Billing and card steps; draft, Why? and judging out of allowance. The allowance was run down by editing the disposable database.

entries.requirement: No free tier; capped $0.50 shared allowance, no top-ups without a card; access ends with the 7 days; a card in the trial is charged at its end, in the last hour or after it at once and only with consent; a decline never shortens it.
entries.notes: Fake card processor. Stale and missing terms gave 409 with no charge; six concurrent confirmed submits made one $5 charge; the expiry tick ended a trial with no visit.
